Greg Hoppan <al...@mail.datanet.hu> wrote:
> 1. Is Theft of Vitae usable at close range?
> 2. Is Eldritch Glimmer usable at close range?

Yes to both questions.
Just because something is usable at long range doesn't
mean that it isn't usable at close range.

Compare Thrown Sewer Lid, which is "only usable at
long range". Without the "only" qualifier, a ranged
strike is usable at long ro close range.
